basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old digital marketing associate living in Austin, Texas. I recently got into gaming and love exploring different story-driven games like OMORI. I enjoy watching anime, especially classics like Rurouni Kenshin, and have a soft spot for basset hounds. Outside of work, I spend my free time learning about evolutionary psychology and occasionally bingeing on random YouTube rabbit holes. I usually browse Reddit during lunch breaks and late evenings. Currently single, and always on the lookout for new hobbies and interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Marketing and have developed a keen interest in digital strategies and consumer behavior. My knowledge in gaming and anime is fairly new, fueled by recommendations from friends and online communities. I often learn through online forums, YouTube tutorials, and by diving headfirst into new topics.
